messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly submission nudges + owner rotation: please update forecast and stage by EOD

Team — quick weekly nudge as we close the month. Please do the following by EOD today (Thursday):

1) Update commit status for all active deals in your lanes (ensure Close Date and ARR are current).
2) Confirm stage ownership if a deal is in negotiation / legal (use the owner-rotation sheet attached).
3) Tag any deals with >50% risk and add a single-line rationale in the HS notes.

Priority lanes this week: Acme Payments (Karthik), Solaria Health (Laura), Terra Cloud (Marissa).

I attached a quick pipeline snapshot for Acme — Karthik, Laura, can you confirm whether the 6/28 demo was factored into the probability change? If not, update glide path and we’ll rerun the submission.

Agenda for the forecast huddle (15m) at 10:30 PT:
- Quick lane highlights (each owner, 2m)
- Blockers & risk tags (5m)
- Any requested escalations/credits (5m)
- Quick roll call on owner rotation (3m)

If you expect issues hitting EOD, flag in reply and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks —
Priyom
